data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter widget for ripple and pulse animations.
data.what_it_does: Creates concentric circular ripple waves and pulsing glowing effects around any Flutter widget. It uses native CustomPainter and AnimationController for performance across platforms.
use_when: You need to add a radar beacon, pulsing avatar, or incoming call wave effect around a widget.
You want high performance ripple animations without adding external dependencies.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based motion or vector animations like Rive and Lottie.
You are implementing page transitions rather than widget-level animations.
strengths: High performance CustomPainter implementation running at 60/120 FPS
Fully customizable properties including wave count, radius, duration, and color
weaknesses: Limited to circular ripple and pulsing wave effects

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick flutter_animate if you need a comprehensive, chainable animation system for all kinds of widget transitions and effects rather than just specific ripple waves.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick lottie if you want complex designer-made animations exported from After Effects.

alternatives.name: rive
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick rive if you need interactive, state-driven vector animations.

data.minimal_example:
RippleAnimation(
  color: Colors.blue,
  delay: const Duration(milliseconds: 100),
  repeat: true,
  minRadius: 50,
  ripplesCount: 4,
  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 2000),
  child: const CircleAvatar(
    minRadius: 50,
    maxRadius: 50,
    child: Icon(Icons.person, size: 40),
  ),
)
